name: The Room
source:
What would you do closed in a room with the only other things being your bed, a mirror and a computer display that does not work? The Room will let you explore this strange world in a little thought experiment.

[from [url=http://michalmoroz.com/the-room/?p=the-room]official site[/url]]
translation:
如果被关在一个房间里，里面除了你的床、一面镜子，以及一台无法工作的电脑显示器，什么也没有，你会怎么做？《房间》将通过一个小小的思想实验，让你探索这个奇怪的世界。

[摘自[url=http://michalmoroz.com/the-room/?p=the-room]官方网站[/url]]
